kjv: at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon
mine: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon
note: The MT omits the name. I supplied "Jeiel" from the parallel list in 9:35, as several manuscripts and versions do. The KJV follows the MT.

Both keep the form with "Baal". 2 Samuel calls him "Mephibosheth", with bosheth ("shame") substituted for Baal. Chronicles preserves the original names Merib-baal and Esh-baal (v. 33). There is no difference here; this is noted for the summary.
